scope: One isolated Claude quota-after-completed-Read no-input native continuation, reviewed and run on macOS and Linux
review: V2 actual execution is unqualified because its diagnostic-history duplicate oracle was defective. Astra review found V3 paired-role blocks accepted; V3 was not run. V4 corrected the oracle and was reviewed; this remains a narrow positive, not a readiness gate.
behavior: A completed Read and typed subscription-quota error were observed in the original native session. A fresh native process continued with initialize only under the narrow continuation environment flag; no host input or replayed task was supplied.
The continuation retained the original session UUID and tool-result context, reached a final answer, and preserved normal settings, instructions, project hook and deny rule.
The original history rows remained unchanged across continuation. Both runs used generated private homes, fake credentials, a nonforwarding loopback server, and exact owned-process cleanup.

prior_outcomes.v2: Actual run remains unqualified because the diagnostic-history duplicate oracle invalidated the result.
prior_outcomes.v3: Not run: Astra review found paired-role blocks accepted; V4 corrected the role oracle.
prior_outcomes.v4: Corrected and reviewed history oracle; both platform receipts qualify only for the narrow case above.

limits: This does not establish readiness, general quota recovery, terminal UI equivalence or complete workflow parity.
The test used explicit synthetic trust and fixture choices. No live accounts, discussions or production setup were used.
No product activation is authorized or implied.
remaining_gates: Unanswered-question durable-state characterization and its recovery negative remain pending.
Permission, cancellation, queued input, background work, MCP/workflow parity and live account handover remain unqualified.

subsequent_negatives.review: V1 was not run: review found unread late callbacks and loose original-state qualification. Root and Astra reviewed V2 joined callback census, exact fixture predicates and startup/quiet liveness before native execution.

runs.limit: Actual unanswered native callback and requires_action occurred, but no native history file existed after immediate stop. No successor was constructed; this does not test recovery.
